bounds: Do not repeat rejected C2 zones/S06 or re-label them as new candidates. New defence hypothesis requires distinct evidence, prospective primary/benefit multiplicity, dated sources and a bounded budget before outcomes.

Before B1 candidate outcomes, freeze one distinct mechanism selected from input quality, modelling or possession decision pathways; at most3 variants TOTAL, one200-game development screen and one disjoint200-game independent screen. Audit baseline on development only; conceal independent outcomes/baseline until candidate freeze. Broader confirmation/stress requires a survivor. Defence is not mandatory if another supported error source dominates.

B2 first repairs historical Cup-final labels and season-specific calendar/version leakage. Freeze at most three starting-rating/memory candidates before validation; use the16 explicit origins in historical_pathway_panel from completed2022-23 through2025-26 seasons. Full-calendar/postseason calibration cannot be claimed from scheduled-only historical paths.

Fit carry-over/opponent/drift/absence auxiliaries strictly before each origin. Missing dated absence evidence retains no-hazard fallback; no arbitrary variance multiplier or from-final-results retune.

B2 selection uses leave-one-season-out; final historical confirmation or protected full-season truth must satisfy a prospectively explicit versioned pathway policy. Incomplete2026-27 final-season truth cannot establish calibrated title probabilities.
At most10 heavy threads including inner BLAS/OMP/compression. Parallelise disjoint panels/I/O; canonical1k chunks preserve world identity. No agent delegation implied.
Existing accepted history already shares shots across likely defenders in broad zones. Source audit must identify an actual new mechanism, not relabel the existing history as new work.
No defender positions exist at each shot in retained ESPN segments. Rank means likelihood, not measured physical proximity; top2 research hook is not proof of production activation.
Separate primary defence from help only if source evidence can support/validate it; unsupported roles stay unknown. Inferred weights must sumone per eligible shot; exclusions/missing fives explicit.

For per-origin forecasts all responsibility fits and profile histories precede origin. Hold out games for assignment validation; do not classify a made shot to a weak defender or missed shot to a strong defender based on that outcome.
U25 is PWA-only and delivered before B; use its design system rather than creating another website. Manual import remains required on both devices.

Historical season labels are ENDING years2023-26, not calendar-year origins. Exact16 dates are frozen above; none accesses protected2026-27 outcomes. Rotation maps require all weighted worlds, never selected extremes.

acceptance.B1: New source-safe input/model/decision mechanism passes owner_team_score_contract and player-first promotion safeguards with independent confirmation; otherwise retainr3 and record the team-score objective as unmet.
acceptance.B2: All16 origins, per-date paired CRPS/dispersion/coverage/persistence with cutoff-safe fitting and exact mixture accounting; qualified version or measured rejection retainspathway-v1.
acceptance.B3: Applicable combined/removal/independent/seed/10k/cutoff/runtime checks plus explicit owner team-score target result; stored error evidence/rotation visibility, final full nightly and tested PWA/checkpoint. UI delivery does not earn team-score accuracy credit.

fallback: Retain accepted models on failed/unsupported evidence, publish the measured gap and a bounded successor. Research rejection is valid evidence; team-score objective remains unmet unless its independent target passes. Preserve all sources/results and manual device-import limitation.

supersedes.reason: Owner explicitly prioritises closer real-life team totals via stronger play-by-play inputs, models or decision pathways; defence is a possible mechanism, not the preselected solution.

historical_pathway_panel.selection: Leave one complete season out; origin and fitted auxiliaries strictly prior; no November/December2026 or later origin
historical_pathway_panel.early_support: Audit November2022 cold-start/prior support before outcomes. Missing prior history uses the prospectively frozen common uninformative baseline; never future history or silent origin deletion.

owner_team_score_contract.meaning: Primary target is each team score, home and away; also audit their combined game total and margin. Regulation and full-game/OT truth must be matched exactly.
owner_team_score_contract.product_target: Where independent baseline mean team-score bias is detectably nonzero (whole-game bootstrap95% interval excludes0), target at least25% reduction in its absolute magnitude versus r3. If baseline is already consistent with zero, do not manufacture a percentage gain: require bias within a prospectively frozen practical tolerance instead.
owner_team_score_contract.accuracy_gate: Independently confirmed paired mean team-points CRPS improvement: whole-game bootstrap95% CI for control-minus-candidate lies above0. Also report MAE/RMSE so cancelling over/under errors cannot masquerade as accuracy; freeze any additional practical effect-size/tolerance before candidate outcomes.
owner_team_score_contract.player_first: Retain all applicable v3 player-tier proper-score/coverage and game-total/margin/winner non-inferiority safeguards. Sum players to teams exactly; do not sacrifice player distributions to cosmetically repair team totals.
diagnosis: Possession count and duration versus observed event support
Shot opportunities, zone/type mix and conversion
Free throws, foul events, turnovers and offensive rebounds
Minutes, lineup composition, on-court defence and uncertainty
prohibitions: No arbitrary final-score shift, multiplier, clipping or display-only correction
No market-line fitting as a substitute for real results
No retuning closed C2/S06 attempts or protected-r3 rescoring
No claiming reduced average bias alone as better per-game forecasting
owner_team_score_contract.closure: Owner team-score outcome earns acceptance only when the independent target and safeguards pass. Negative research may close a bounded investigation, but cannot satisfy this outcome; retain accepted models, state the gap explicitly and carry the objective into a fully specified successor. Dashboard-only delivery never fulfils it.
